rows.grounds: Sandhi-fused form: mantradevān (mantra-deva, accusative plural) + tataḥ (then); refers to the deities of the mantras.
The ritual practitioner who employs the mantra.
Sandhi-fused form: dhyāyet (optative of dhyai, to meditate) + susthira-mānasaḥ (bahuvrīhi adjective, having a very steady mind).
